summary: Early brawler who wins short melee trades with alternating punches, then turns damage he takes into a true-damage W. He has no ranged option and only one gap closer (Q speed), so kiting and denying his Grit build-up beat him.
threats: Grit: damage he takes fills his Grit bar, and W (Haymaker) spends it for a shield and a true-damage centre hit.
E (Facebreaker) pulls champions on both sides of him together; it stuns if he catches someone on each side.
Q (Knuckle Down) gives speed toward champions and empowers his next two punches.
R (The Show Stopper) at 5: suplexes you, dealing damage to everyone where you land.

matchups.why: Sett has no ranged option, so Vayne kites him all lane. W (Silver Bolts) true damage shreds his HP, and Condemn knocks him back when he uses Q speed to run at her.
trading: Auto him whenever he walks up to farm; he can't reach you without Q.
When he Qs at you, Tumble (Q) away or Condemn him back.
Stand next to a wall so Condemn can stun him.
Don't stand still in front of a full Grit bar; walk out of the W centre line.
matchups.early: Kite and farm. He wants to brawl, so never let him get into melee range for free.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R can suplex you into his team or tower. Play away from tower when you're low.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and kite; take plates when he backs.
matchups.jungle: He has no escape besides Q speed. Gank when it's down.
matchups.build: Lethal Tempo. Crit and on-hit; armor boots if behind.
matchups.remember: Kite the Q, dodge the Haymaker centre.

matchups.why: Riposte parries Sett's E stun or W Haymaker and stuns him back, and vitals' true damage cuts through his HP. Fiora wins every trade where he wastes his key spell into her W.
trading: Hold W (Riposte) for his W Haymaker or E stun.
Lunge onto vitals, then get out before his Grit bar fills.
Don't let him trade alternating punches with you for free; Q away.
If he Ws into your Riposte, punish with a full vitals combo.
matchups.early: Trade on vitals from level 1 and deny his Grit build-up by keeping trades short.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R heal zone wins extended fights; his R is a threat near his tower.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and take plates while he can't trade back.
matchups.jungle: He's slow without Q. Gank once he's used it.

matchups.why: Both are early brawlers. Darius wins extended fights once Hemorrhage stacks, but Sett's W Haymaker turns the damage Darius deals into a true-damage burst. The lane comes down to who controls trade length.
trading: E (Apprehend) pull him when he walks up, then stack Hemorrhage quickly.
Step out of his W centre line; the true damage is in the middle.
Hit the outer edge of Q on him to heal through his punches.
Back off when his Grit bar is full and his W is up.
matchups.early: Even. Force long fights where your stacks matter more than his Grit.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R resets on kill; his R can suplex you. Count stacks before going in.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and trade on cooldown windows.
matchups.jungle: He escapes with Q speed. Gank after he's used it.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Armor boots; Sett's early damage is physical.

matchups.why: Sett's punches out-trade Nasus early, and every time Nasus walks up to stack Q he's in range for an E stun and W true-damage burst. Nasus can only farm safely and outscale.
trading: W (Wither) him when he Qs at you to slow his run-in and his punches.
Stack Q only when his Q is on cooldown.
Step out of his W centre line; it deals true damage.
Back off once his Grit bar is full.
matchups.early: Give up some creeps and farm under tower. Don't trade into his punches.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R gives HP and resists to survive his all-in, but don't start one.
matchups.wave: Farm under tower; stack Q on cannon minions.
matchups.jungle: Ask for an early gank when he overextends without Q.
